```{r test treatment allocation based on v1 and v2}

n = 100
set.seed(21332)

# Creat Correlation Matrix for 4 initial variables z
correlation_matrix = simdata::cor_from_upper(
  4, 
  rbind(c(1,2,0.1), c(1,3,0.5), c(1,4,0.1),
        c(2,3,0.6), c(2,4,-0.2),
        c(3,4,-0.5)))

# define Transformation for initial variables z into v1,v2,v3,v4
transformation = simdata::function_list(
  v1 = function(z) floor(10 * z[,1] + 55), 
  v2 = function(z) exp(0.5 * z[,2] + 1.5), 
  v3 = function(z) exp(0.4 * z[,3] + 3),
  v4 = function(z) floor(pmax(0, 25 * exp(z[,4]) - 5))
)

# Define simulation design with correlation, transformation, and from a multivariate normal distribution
sim_design = simdata::simdesign_mvtnorm(
  relations = correlation_matrix,
  transform_initial = transformation,
  prefix_final = NULL
)

# Simulate dataset sim_data with variables v1,v2,v3,v4
sim_data = simdata::simulate_data(sim_design, n_obs = n)

sim_data$v1
sim_data$v2


logit_p <- -4 + 0.085 * sim_data$v1 - 0.35 * sim_data$v2  # Logistic function linear predictor
p_treat <- 1 / (1 + exp(-logit_p))     # Convert to probability

p_treat

# Impact of v1 on treatment probability
plot(sim_data$v1, p_treat)

# Impact of v2 on treatment probability
plot(sim_data$v2, p_treat)
```

```{r test survival time}

set.seed(213)
n = 100
beta_v1 <- 0.05
beta_v4 <- 0.1
beta_treatment <- -0.7

baseline_lambda = 0.05
p_weibull = 0.7

# Create Correlation Matrix for 4 initial variables z
  correlation_matrix = simdata::cor_from_upper(
    4, 
    rbind(c(1,2,0.1), c(1,3,0.5), c(1,4,0.1),
          c(2,3,0.6), c(2,4,-0.2),
          c(3,4,-0.5)))
  
  # define Transformation for initial variables z into v1,v2,v3,v4
  transformation = simdata::function_list(
    v1 = function(z) floor(10 * z[,1] + 55), 
    v2 = function(z) exp(0.5 * z[,2] + 1.5), 
    v3 = function(z) exp(0.4 * z[,3] + 3),
    v4 = function(z) floor(pmax(0, 25 * exp(z[,4]) - 5))
  )
  
  # Define simulation design with correlation, transformation, and from a multivariate normal distribution
  sim_design = simdata::simdesign_mvtnorm(
    relations = correlation_matrix,
    transform_initial = transformation,
    prefix_final = NULL
  )
  
  # Simulate dataset sim_data with variables v1,v2,v3,v4
sim_data = simdata::simulate_data(sim_design, n_obs = n)


# Step 2: Generate treatment assignment
# Default behavior: treatment probability depends on confounders v1 and v2
    logit_p <- -4 + 0.085 * sim_data$v1 - 0.35 * sim_data$v2  # Logistic function linear predictor
    p_treat <- 1 / (1 + exp(-logit_p))     # Convert to probability

Treatment <- rbinom(n, 1, p_treat)  # Assign treatment based on probability

# Step 3: Generate Weibull survival times
lin_pred <- beta_v1 * sim_data$v1 + beta_v4 * sim_data$v4 + beta_treatment * Treatment
scale_param <- exp(lin_pred)  # Convert to scale parameter
  
  # Weibull survival times
SurvivalTime <- ( (-log(runif(n))) / (baseline_lambda * scale_param) )^(1/p_weibull)

SurvivalTime
  


```

```{r test observed time}
source("Generate_Data.R")

data <- simulate_survival_data()
summary(data$ObservedTime)
```

```{r show kaplan meier curve}
library(survival)
source("Generate_Data.R")

set.seed(1234)

data <- Generate_Data(n = 1000,
                      beta_treatment = -0.7)

# kaplan meier curve
fit <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ Treatment, data = data)
plot(fit, col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival Probability", xlim = c(0,30),
     main = "Weibull Survival Simulation")
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Control", "Treatment"), col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2)
abline(v = 10)

```

# Relation of X1 X2 and X4 to treatment and outcome

```{r}
source("Generate_Data.R")

set.seed(1234)

df <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                    beta_X1 = -0.3,
                    beta_X4 = 0.45)

# Basic correlations with survival time (continuous)
cor_with_survival <- cor(df[, c("X1", "X2", "X3", "X4", "SurvivalTime")])
print(cor_with_survival["SurvivalTime", ])

# Logistic regression for Treatment assignment
glm_treatment <- glm(Treatment ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4, data = df, family = binomial)
summary(glm_treatment)

# Linear approximation to survival predictors
lm_survival <- lm(SurvivalTime ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4, data = df)
summary(lm_survival)


# Linear approximation to observed time
lm_survival <- lm(ObservedTime ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + Treatment, data = df)
summary(lm_survival)




```

# Grid search for 20%, 40% and 60% censoring before rmst time 10

```{r}
library(dplyr)
source("Generate_Data.R")

set.seed(1234)

# Create sequences for the two parameters
max_censoring_seq <- seq(10, 20, by = 1)
censoring_rate_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.2, by = 0.01)

# Generate all combinations
grid <- expand.grid(
  max_censoring_time_unif = max_censoring_seq,
  censoring_rate = censoring_rate_seq
)

# Add third column of zeros
grid$censoring_at_time_10 <- 0

for(i in 1:nrow(grid)) {
  df_temp <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                           max_censoring_time_unif = grid$max_censoring_time_unif[i],
                           censoring_rate = grid$censoring_rate[i])
  
  # get censoring proportions
  grid$censoring_at_time_10 [i] <- round(mean(df_temp$censoring_time <= 10), digits = 2)
}

filtered_grid <- grid %>%
  filter(
    between(censoring_at_time_10, 0.17, 0.23) |
    between(censoring_at_time_10, 0.37, 0.43) |
    between(censoring_at_time_10, 0.57, 0.63)
  )

filtered_grid <- arrange(filtered_grid, censoring_at_time_10)
grid <- arrange(grid, censoring_at_time_10)

```

Die Werte sind: 20 und 0.02 für 20%, 20 und 0.06 für 40%, 15 und 0.08 für 60%

# Calculate true treatment effect and show it graphically

```{r Calculate}
source("Generate_Data.R")
# simulate big dataset for the same individuals, once with treatment for everyone, once with treatment for no one

set.seed(1)
data_all_treatment <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                                    p_treat_manual = 1,
                                    beta_treatment = -0.5)

set.seed(1)
data_no_treatment <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                                   p_treat_manual = 0,
                                   beta_treatment = -0.5)

data <- rbind(data_all_treatment, data_no_treatment)
```

```{r Show difference}
library(survival)
source("Generate_Data.R")

# kaplan meier curve
fit <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ Treatment, data = data)
plot(fit, col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival Probability", xlim = c(0,30),
     main = "True Treatment difference")
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Control", "Treatment"), col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2)
abline(v = 10)

data_simulated_normally <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                                         beta_treatment = -0.5)
# kaplan meier curve
fit <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ Treatment, data = data_simulated_normally)
plot(fit, col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival Probability", xlim = c(0,30),
     main = "Descriptive Treatment difference")
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Control", "Treatment"), col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2)
abline(v = 10)
```

```{r function for descriptive vs true treatment effect}
descriptive_vs_true <- function(beta_treatment, treatment_shape_effect){
  
  library(survival)
  library(ggplot2)
  source("Generate_Data.R")
  
  # simulate big dataset for the same individuals, once with treatment for everyone, once with treatment for no one

  set.seed(1)
  data_all_treatment <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                                      p_treat_manual = 1,
                                      beta_treatment = beta_treatment,
                                      treatment_shape_effect = treatment_shape_effect,
                                      censoring = FALSE)

  set.seed(1)
  data_no_treatment <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                                    p_treat_manual = 0,
                                    beta_treatment = beta_treatment,
                                    treatment_shape_effect = treatment_shape_effect,
                                    censoring = FALSE)

  data <- rbind(data_all_treatment, data_no_treatment)
  
  # kaplan meier curve
  fit <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ Treatment, data = data)
  plot(fit, col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival Probability", xlim = c(0,30),
       main = "True Treatment difference")
  legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Control", "Treatment"), col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2)
  abline(v = 10)

  data_simulated_normally <- Generate_Data(n = 100000,
                                           beta_treatment = beta_treatment,
                                           treatment_shape_effect = treatment_shape_effect,
                                           censoring = FALSE)
  # kaplan meier curve
  fit <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ Treatment, data = data_simulated_normally)
  plot(fit, col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival Probability", xlim = c(0,30),
       main = "Descriptive Treatment difference")
  legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Control", "Treatment"), col = c("red", "blue"), lty = 1:2)
  abline(v = 10)
  
  # Calculate RMST for both curves
  
  # Compute the Kaplan-Meier curves
  km_fit_all_treatment <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ 1, data = data_all_treatment)  # One curve for all individuals
  km_fit_no_treatment <- survfit(Surv(ObservedTime, Status) ~ 1, data = data_no_treatment)  # One curve for all individuals
  
  # Extract RMST at time tau
  RMST_all_treatment <- survival:::survmean(km_fit_all_treatment, rmean=10)[[1]]["rmean"]
  RMST_no_treatment <- survival:::survmean(km_fit_no_treatment, rmean=10)[[1]]["rmean"] 
  
  # Create a data frame for plotting
  df <- data.frame(
    Group = c("Treatment", "Control"),
    RMST = c(RMST_all_treatment, RMST_no_treatment)
  )

  # Plot
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = RMST, fill = Group)) +
   geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treatment" = "blue", "Control" = "red")) +
   labs(y = "RMST", x = "") +
   theme_minimal() +
   theme(legend.position = "none")
  
}

descriptive_vs_true(beta_treatment = -0.5, treatment_shape_effect = 0) # positive treatment effect, PH holds
descriptive_vs_true(beta_treatment = 0, treatment_shape_effect = 0) # no treatment effect
descriptive_vs_true(beta_treatment = 0.5, treatment_shape_effect = -0.3) # both RMST equal
descriptive_vs_true(beta_treatment = -0.7, treatment_shape_effect = 0.37) # crossing KM curves

# descriptive_vs_true(beta_treatment = 0.7, treatment_shape_effect = -0.37) # crossing KM curves
```
